cards.title: Synthetic revenue recognition guidance
cards.text: Recognise revenue when control of the promised service transfers to the customer (synthetic test rule).

cards.title: Synthetic revenue recognition guidance (revised)
cards.text: From 1 January 2026, multi-element contracts must also allocate price by relative stand-alone selling price (synthetic test rule). Not retroactive.

cards.title: Entity capitalisation policy
cards.text: Capitalise equipment above USD 5,000 (synthetic test rule).

cards.title: Group finance memo
cards.text: Capitalise equipment above USD 2,500 (synthetic test rule).
